scope: Candidate development only, on the word corpus model/prefix_v3: words of the base corpus's training split and of the CC0 Tatoeba snapshot typed in the other layout and as meant, and real tokens typed as meant, each in three of four situations. No test is read. Epoch chosen on development (zero false sequences in both profiles), threshold on calibration, the prefixes measured as the engine asks about them. Promotion requires the frozen joint engine evaluation and the sealed holdout test.
training_revision: v88-3: schema three, importance scaled to a mean of one, a prefix typed in the other layout converts from four letters unless it continues a word of its layout's lexicon or begins a known term, early stop after fifteen epochs without progress; diagnostic: the epoch of least development loss among those with a zero-false frontier
